response.original_title: 【Official™-Guide】 How to communicate on Holland America Cruise?
response.overview: You can communicate while on a Holland America cruise using the Holland America Navigator App for onboard messaging, purchasing Wi-Fi packages for internet access, or using stateroom telephones for calls +1-855-732-4023 or +44-289-708-0062 (UK).  Onboard Messaging & Apps Navigator App: Connect to the ship's Wi-Fi network in airplane mode to use the app's free chat feature to message other passengers onboard. Mixed Feedback: On Reddit, users have mixed opinions on the Navigator app; many report that notifications can be delayed, and the chat feature can occasionally be unreliable or crash. Contacting the Ship from Land (Emergencies) Ship Dial Service: Family and friends can call a ship directly for critical emergencies using designated numbers (such as +1-855-732-4023 or +44-289-708-0062 (UK) in the U.S.), though a credit card is required for inbound calls. You must provide the ship's name, guest's name, and stateroom number.
